name: ferrule
description: Run the Ferrule coding agent on the open folder and approve each change in VS Code.

ferrule.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter that has Ferrule's dependencies, e.g. D:\GenAI_projects\Multi-Model Coding Agent\.venv\Scripts\python.exe

ferrule.ferruleDir.description: Folder that contains the ferrule package and its .env file. Ferrule runs from here with 'python -m ferrule'.

ferrule.localOnly.description: Never send code or prompts to hosted models (passes --local-only).
